_note: Team pages (task 5.20): one page per roster (league + Sleeper roster_id), reports/team.html?league=<current league id>&roster=<id>, filled in the browser from data/teams/<league slug>-<roster>.json (scripts/team_pages.py). The page is listed in config/nav.json; links to it from Standings and Games follow that tab's state (hidden-dev = Dev view only).
_position_order_note: Current-roster groups in this order; any other position (or none) goes in a last 'Other' group.
_transactions_shown_note: Transactions listed before 'Show more'; each press shows this many more. Safe default 25.
_startup_draft_min_rounds_note: A draft with more rounds than this is labelled a startup draft (2019 founding leagues, 2020/2021 expansion leagues); otherwise a rookie draft.
_current_season_open_note: Season by season: the current season's block starts open, past seasons start closed.
